description:
Reproduction: call Observable.GenServer.notify_cell_each with last=1 and an identity projection, then new_state=nil. The entry records last=nil but sends no message. The delivery reducer uses nil as its no-delivery sentinel.
Instructions: return tagged delivery decisions (:unchanged or {:changed, value}, or equivalent) from update_cell_subscriber. Keep saturation and dead-subscriber behavior intact; never use a valid projected value as control flow.
Acceptance: live GenServer transport tests cover non-nil -> nil, repeated nil producing no second notification, nil -> non-nil, and batched updates with one nil projection.
title: Deliver nil Cell values instead of treating them as no update
